spans.s: कौतुक n. 1. Desire, curiosity; 2. eagerness, vehemence; 3. anything creating curiosity, a wonder; 4. festivity, gaiety; 5. marriage thread worn on the wrist, R.viii.1; 6. the ceremony with the marriage thread preceding a marriage; 7. joy, pleasure, happiness; 8. joke, fun; 9. song, dance, show; 10. friendly greeting, salutation.
कौतुक-अगार m.n. a room for festivity, a pleasure house, कौतुकागारमागात् K.S.vii.94.
कौतुक-गृह n. a room for festivity, a pleasure house, कौतुकागारमागात् K.S.vii.94.
कौतुक-क्रिया f. a solemn ceremony, a marriage ceremony, R.xi.53.
कौतुक-मंगल n. a solemn ceremony, a marriage ceremony, R.xi.53.
कौतुक-तोरण m.n. a triumphal arch erected at a festival.
कौतूहल(ल्य) n. 1. Desire, curiosity, interest, विषयव्यावृतकौतूहाः Vikr.i.; 2. eagerness, vehemence; 3. anything causing curiosity.
कौतूहल(ल्य) n. 1. Desire, curiosity, interest, विषयव्यावृतकौतूहाः Vikr.i.; 2. eagerness, vehemence; 3. anything causing curiosity.
